Joe Sacco's Muzaffarnagar Riots Book Finds New Indian Publisher

A new book by graphic journalist Joe Sacco, focusing on the 2013 Muzaffarnagar riots, has secured a new Indian publisher. The book, titled 'The Once and Future Riot', was previously dropped by Penguin India. It explores the events and their aftermath through Sacco's characteristic journalistic style.
